title: The Bond of Friendship
summary: In the rugged mountains of Greece lived two young shepherds, Aphtanides and Anastasios. Bound by the ancient rite of brotherhood, they swore to share one another's joy and sorrow,...
keywords: the shepherd's story of the bond of friendship
full_text:
In the rugged mountains of Greece lived two young shepherds, Aphtanides and Anastasios. Bound by the ancient rite of brotherhood, they swore to share one another's joy and sorrow, protection and defense, even unto death.

When Turkish brigands raided their mountain village and carried off Anastasios's lovely sister, the two youths rode together into the enemy's mountain stronghold.

Surrounded by overwhelming numbers, Aphtanides took an enemy lance through his shoulder to shield his sworn brother, while Anastasios cut down the guards and carried the maiden to safety. Together, they escaped through the rocky crags, nursing one another's wounds beneath the stars.

The shepherd's flute still echoes their song through the olive groves of Attica, reminding the world that friendship sealed with selflessness is an unbreakable shield against all adversity.
moral: Sacred friendship consecrated by hardship is a bond stronger than blood or mortal danger.
